body:
Thank you for this issue.

I confirmed it.
I think `max-statements-per-line` rule should ignore empty statements because empty statements are warned by `no-extra-semi` rule.

Should this be fixed already in 2.10.1?
If so I am still having the same issue.
@vtfn oh, I see. I missed the first line and it seems I didn't completely fix the issue.

Ops, I confirmed it. It's my mistake.

![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/1937871/15269457/c16a21a4-1a39-11e6-8ced-454190d670be.png)

The `const` declaration have that range, so 2 statements exist in line 5.
We should use the last token's position instead of node's position at [max-statements-per-line.js#L78](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/blob/51e05af39829b047cead58c1f89f0f3d48bba7dc/lib/rules/max-statements-per-line.js#L78)
@mysticatea I am not sure what you are proposing, or what to do here, since we shouldn't skip every multiline statement. Do you want to take over this?
